channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — FinTech
channel.description: Latest FinTech stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: EIB unlocks half of planned €800 million in financing for Romania’s Cernavodă nuclear plant refurbishment
item.description: The EIB has released €400 million of a planned €800 million loan to refurbish Romania's Cernavodă nuclear plant, securing long-term low-carbon energy for the region.

item.title: Digital firms drive surge in business R&D as government R&D budgets across the OECD fall for a second consecutive year
item.description: Global public R&D budgets are declining for a second year while private sector digital and AI R&D spending surges by double digits.

item.title: EIC Fund companies highlight its role in supporting fundraising and growth
item.description: A new EIC Fund survey confirms its vital role in startup fundraising and credibility, while highlighting a growing focus on dual-use and defense technologies.

item.title: Infocredit Group and Mastercard to Sponsor the 27th NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum in Cyprus
item.description: Meet the team on 19 November 2026 at the Four Seasons Hotel in Limassol to discuss financial crime compliance, payment fraud prevention and third-party cyber risk.

item.title: CYPRUS INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ENTREPRISES ASSOCIATION EVENT
item.description: CITEA hosted a networking event to promote synergies among Cyprus IT companies and highlight international development opportunities through the Trade Service.

item.title: Kava Lend loses roughly $3.8 million to hack, sending KAVA token down nearly 40%
item.description: DeFi lending protocol Kava Lend suffered a $3.8 million exploit, causing the KAVA token to plummet by 40% amid wider market stability concerns.

item.title: Scams: What to watch out for ahead of Black Friday and Christmas shopping traffic
item.description: Cyprus banks warn of a seasonal surge in phishing and social engineering scams targeting consumers during the Black Friday and Christmas shopping period.

item.title: The European Innovation Council selects 35 deep tech companies for its Accelerator support
item.description: The European Innovation Council awards €84 million to 35 deep tech companies, offering grants and equity to scale breakthrough innovations across the EU.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $1 billion for the second week in a row as crypto funds, except one, continue bleeding
item.description: Bitcoin ETFs recorded over $1 billion in weekly outflows for the second consecutive week, signaling a cooling of institutional crypto demand amid market volatility.

item.title: CYPRUS SHAPES ITS DIGITAL FUTURE: CLOUD, TALENT AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN THE SPOTLIGHT
item.description: CITEA and government officials convened to align on Cyprus' National AI Strategy, "Cloud First" public sector policy, and international talent acquisition to drive digital competitiveness.

item.title: TEMU PARTNERS WITH CITEA TO SUPPORT CYPRUS’ DIGITAL BUSINESS COMMUNITY
item.description: Global e-commerce giant Temu has partnered with CITEA to integrate Cyprus's ICT sector and local merchants into its international digital commerce ecosystem.

item.title: CITEA AND INVEST CYPRUS STRENGTHEN COOPERATION FOR CYPRUS’ DIGITAL DEVELOPMENT AND INTERNATIONAL OUTREACH
item.description: CITEA and Invest Cyprus have signed an MoU to bridge local tech firms with international investors, focusing on AI strategy and digital transformation.

item.title: Regulation as a Competitive Advantage: How the European Framework Strengthens Cyprus as an International Financial Centre
item.description: Cyprus is leveraging the EU's rigorous regulatory framework to pivot from a 'light-touch' jurisdiction to a trusted, high-credibility hub for institutional investment and fintech operations.

item.title: Strengthening Resilience in the Cyprus Funds Industry
item.description: The Cyprus funds industry faces heightened operational risks due to the unprecedented scale and complexity of EU restrictive measures post-2022.

item.title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AT THE CORE OF DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION AT THE 5th DIGITAL CYPRUS CONFERENCE 2026
item.description: The 5th Digital Cyprus Conference highlighted Artificial Intelligence as the primary driver for national digital transformation and economic competitiveness in the Cypriot business landscape.

item.title: REMARKABLE SUCCESS FOR THE 2ND CITEA DIGITAL CYPRUS CONFERENCE
item.description: The 2nd CITEA Digital Cyprus Conference drew 600+ delegates to discuss AI, cybersecurity, and digital transformation trends shaping the local business landscape.

item.title: Global standard-setting bodies publish a toolkit for cyber resilience at FMIs and a discussion paper on FMIs’ reliance on third-party service providers
item.description: Global standard-setters CPMI-IOSCO have released a cyber resilience toolkit and a discussion paper on third-party risks for financial market infrastructures, seeking industry feedback.

item.title: Basel III risk-based capital and leverage ratios are stable while liquidity indicators show limited movements for large internationally active banks, latest Basel III monitoring exercise shows
item.description: The latest Basel III monitoring report shows stable capital and leverage ratios for major banks, with a minor increase in minimum required capital impact to 2.2%.

item.title: International supervisory community meets to discuss the future of global bank supervision and regulation
item.description: Global banking supervisors met at ICBS 2026 to discuss modernizing regulation, digital finance impacts, and strengthening cross-border cooperation to ensure financial stability.

item.title: Basel Committee meets to advance supervisory and regulatory initiatives and discuss risks and vulnerabilities to the global banking system
item.description: The Basel Committee is tightening regulations around AI integration, cryptoasset exposures, and machine-readable disclosures to mitigate systemic risks in the global banking sector.

item.title: Basel III applicable in almost all member jurisdictions by 2027
item.description: Basel III implementation enters its final phase, with nearly all member jurisdictions, including EU states, mandated to apply the full standards by April 2027.

item.title: Basel Committee finds Australia, Japan, Korea, Switzerland compliant, and Canada, United Kingdom largely compliant with its leverage ratio framework
item.description: The Basel Committee confirms high levels of compliance with its leverage ratio framework across major global financial hubs, signalling continued regulatory tightening in the banking sector.

item.title: Global standard-setting bodies publish final report on guidance for FMIs on general business risks and general business losses
item.description: Global standard-setters have finalized new guidance for Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) to improve management of general business risks and liquidity requirements.

item.title: Basel Committee finalises measures to address window-dressing in the G-SIB framework and consults on G-SIB methodology review
item.description: The Basel Committee is introducing annual averaging for G-SIB indicators and raising reporting thresholds to curb 'window-dressing' and refine systemic risk assessments by 2030.

item.title: CPMI publishes analysis on how central banks support payment system safety and efficiency and trust in money in the rapidly changing payments ecosystem
item.description: The BIS-CPMI report outlines how central banks must adapt their roles as issuers, operators, and overseers to maintain stability amid rapid fintech innovation and private payment growth.

item.title: Appointments to BIS global payments standard-setting body and Consultative Council for the Americas
item.description: The BIS has appointed new leadership to the CPMI and CCA to oversee global payment standards and regional central bank cooperation in the Americas.

item.title: Resilience Under Pressure: Egypt's Economy Defied Expectations
item.description: Egypt's economy showed resilience against regional instability through policy shifts, yet requires deeper structural reforms to ensure long-term private sector growth.

item.title: Press Briefing Transcript: Julie Kozack, Director, Communications Department, November 12, 2026
item.description: IMF leadership outlines upcoming missions focused on fintech, AI-driven statistics, and regional economic oversight, including visits to Malta and Singapore.

item.title: AI adoption accelerates across the OECD, but major gaps persist among businesses and generations
item.description: OECD report highlights a widening AI divide between large corporations and SMEs, alongside a generational gap in generative AI usage that threatens broad productivity gains.

item.title: Tomorrow’s startups awarded: here are the EIT Jumpstarter 2026 winners
item.description: The EIT Jumpstarter 2026 winners have been announced, showcasing innovative startups from 12 countries in sectors like energy, healthcare, and agritech following intensive market validation.

item.title: GDP up by 0.4% and employment stable in the euro area
item.description: Euro area GDP grew by 0.4% in Q3 2026 while employment remained stable, signaling a moderate economic expansion amid a cooling labor market.

item.title: Theodoros Loucaides leads “From Grant to Growth” panel at Plug and Play Cyprus Expo
item.description: The Research and Innovation Foundation’s Director General brought together a corporate investor, a venture capital co-founder and a startup founder to discuss how Cypriot companies can build on public funding and reach international markets.

item.title: Türkiye to accelerate sustainable development as İLBANK teams up with EIB for advisory support
item.description: The EIB and İLBANK have partnered to provide advisory support for developing low-carbon and climate-resilient municipal infrastructure projects in Turkey.

item.title: Latvia to step up energy-efficient housing drive with EIB loan of €70 million to development finance entity Altum
item.description: The EIB has granted a €70 million loan to Latvia's Altum to finance energy-efficient renovations for 3,900 apartments, aiming for a 40% reduction in energy consumption.

item.title: Opening address by the Minister of Energy, Commerce and Industry, Mr Michael Damianos, at the Cyprus Fintech Summit...
item.description: Cyprus unveils a strategic vision to become a major Fintech gateway connecting Europe with India, the Gulf, and Africa through 2030.

item.title: Update to the Call for Proposals NCC-CY-NIS2/0826 and webinar
item.description: RIF has updated the selection process for the NCC-CY-NIS2/0826 cybersecurity funding call for SMEs, with a dedicated explanatory webinar scheduled for September 28, 2026.

item.title: The Cyprus Stock Excahnge mourns the loss of its Acting General Manager
item.description: The Cyprus Stock Exchange announces the passing of its Acting General Manager, Nikos Tripatsas, marking a period of leadership transition for the national exchange.

item.title: Keynote speech by the Shipping Deputy Minister of the Republic of Cyprus, Ms Marina Hadjimanolis, at the event entitled "Is maritime technology delivering..."
item.description: The Cyprus Shipping Deputy Ministry is prioritizing practical maritime technology delivery and a 'one-stop-shop' digital transformation to solidify the island's position as a global innovation hub.

item.title: Address by the Deputy Minister to the President of the Republic of Cyprus Irene Piki at the Plug and Play Cyprus Expo
item.description: Cyprus celebrates the first Plug and Play Expo, highlighting the nation's status as the EU's fastest-growing startup ecosystem and its push for international scalability.

item.title: Deputy Minister to the President, Research Deputy Minister – Plug and Play Cyprus Expo 2026
item.description: High-level government representation at the Plug and Play Cyprus Expo 2026 signals continued state support for the island's burgeoning startup and fintech ecosystem.

item.title: State Employees by Category: October 2026
item.description: Cyprus state employment rose 0.6% to 55,317 in October 2026, driven by permanent staff and security forces, while short-term contracts saw a sharp decline.

item.title: The Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus contributes to international science diplomacy and AI quantum dialogue at UNESCO
item.description: Cyprus' Chief Scientist engaged in high-level UNESCO dialogues on science diplomacy and the transformative convergence of AI and quantum computing.

item.title: Agriculture Minister – 4th Pancyprian Conference “Rural Development – From Research to Practice”
item.description: The 4th Pancyprian Conference on Rural Development focused on bridging the gap between scientific research and practical agricultural applications to modernize the Cypriot primary sector.

item.title: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises in the euro area (SAFE)
item.description: The ECB’s Q3 2026 SAFE report reveals tightened bank lending conditions and declining profits for euro area firms despite rising turnover.

item.title: The 2026 EIC Pathfinder Challenges call attracts a record interest from breakthrough innovators
item.description: The EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026 call received record-breaking interest with 1,138 proposals, signaling intense competition for €96 million in deep-tech and AI funding.

item.title: Completion of Proposal Submission for the NCC-CY-NIS2/0826 Call for Proposals
item.description: The Research and Innovation Foundation closed its NCC-CY-NIS2 funding call with 21 proposals submitted to bolster cybersecurity compliance.

item.title: Major institutional investors join EIB Group and EU Member States to channel over €10 billion into European scale-ups
item.description: The EIB Group and institutional investors launched a €10 billion+ initiative to provide growth capital for European tech scale-ups, aiming to mobilize €80 billion total.

item.title: EIB Group to showcase new climate finance actions at COP31
item.description: EIB launches a €30 billion Climate Adaptation Plan for 2026-2030, emphasizing green bonds and private capital mobilization for climate resilience projects.

item.title: Monetary policy account
item.description: The European Central Bank maintains a schedule for publishing monetary policy accounts, providing critical insights into the Governing Council's economic evaluations and decision-making processes.

item.title: Climate-related financial disclosures
item.description: The European Central Bank is standardizing climate-related financial disclosures to increase transparency regarding environmental risks within the Eurosystem's portfolios.
